#: canopy-sandbox's template for runtime.setup_cmd, which runs the branch's code in each slot before the worker
starts (HOST_ISOLATION §4.4). canopy sandbox setup copies it to ~/.config/canopy/sandbox/setup.json; fill in
your registries and trim the toolchains to yours there. Keys starting with # are comments; @NAME@ strings are
the paths canopy-sandbox fills in for each run.
Everything not listed is refused. Setup reaches no model and no MCP service: add only the package registries
As worker.json, without the agent runtime's own files. If your workspace is outside HOME, add it to denyRead.
